title: This *BEAR TRAP* Could Be a HUGE PAYDAY Tomorrow!
speaker: Joseph James (Trading With JJ)

macro_themes.view: Strong summer run means buyers are targeting all-time highs; any flush lower into gaps/ranges is a bear trap to buy.

calls.reason: Daily strong run with gap and range support below; hourly bullish range rotation; wants a flush below the overnight low to buy a bear trap and ride the rotation back toward the all-time high.
calls.quote: it looks like buyers are going to be buying up those dips on the way up to reaching that psychological magnet, the all-time high

calls.condition: If price falls, 7675 area is where buyers are expected
calls.reason: Daily strong move and range rotation point to a retest of the all-time high; worst case the range projection lands near 7675 with gaps below, a place to buy not sell; would short only a crown reversal at range underbelly.
calls.quote: all signs right now, they all point to a retest of the all-time high

notes: Recorded Monday night for "Tuesday morning" = Mon Sep 28 (listing Sep 29). Several levels on audio garbled ("790 and a quarter" ATH, "3838", "3356", "3275", "447") and not recorded.
